parameters.query: SELECT ri.id, ri.title, ri.title_normalized, ri.url_hash, ri.source_url, ri.excerpt, ri.published_at, ri.score_source_authority, ri.score_freshness, s.slug as source_slug, s.name as source_name, s.authority_score, c.item_count FROM raw_items ri JOIN sources s ON s.id = ri.source_id LEFT JOIN clusters cl ON cl.id = ri.cluster_id LEFT JOIN clusters c ON c.id = ri.cluster_id WHERE ri.id = $1

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001', max_tokens: 150, system: 'You are a classifier for AI industry news. Respond with valid JSON only.', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Title: ' + $json.title + '
Source: ' + $json.source_name + '
Excerpt: ' + ($json.excerpt || '').split(' ').slice(0,100).join(' ') + '

Output: {"category": "<model_release|tool_launch|research_paper|funding|opinion|tutorial|security|regulation>", "priority_signal": <0-100>, "reasoning": "<one sentence>"}' }] }) }}

parameters.query: UPDATE raw_items SET category = $1, priority_score = $2, score_source_authority = $3, score_cross_coverage = $4, score_freshness = $5, score_engagement = $6, score_author_authority = $7, classification_method = $8, pipeline_status = 'scored' WHERE id = $9
INSERT INTO classification_log (item_id, method, category_result, priority_result) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
UPDATE raw_items SET pipeline_status = 'archived' WHERE id = $1
